b:
Crying,
born with me,
a brother or a sister?

Between the male
and crying
there is a bond
until the moustache
sprouts

After that, men crying
is a disgrace,
women crying
is natural,
many say…

My glands
did not listen

Do tears too
have a gender?
If so, tears
lost…
note: The Tamil word pāl means both "gender" and "milk", so the question "do tears have pāl?" carries both meanings.
